name: Tejo Carrier
subtitle: Offshore Supply Vessel
description: Compact and highly capable offshore supply vessel designed for demanding operations. Features a 900 m² working deck, diesel-electric propulsion, DP II dynamic positioning and hybrid-ready energy storage.

hotspots.name: Compact Size
hotspots.description: Compact and versatile hull designed for nearshore and offshore operations, with accommodation for up to 36 persons.

hotspots.name: Key Capacities
hotspots.description: Optimised cargo tanks for liquid mud and methanol carriage, fully customisable to client requirements.

hotspots.name: Working Deck
hotspots.description: Large unobstructed working deck designed for efficient cargo handling and offshore supply operations.

hotspots.name: Load Capacity
hotspots.description: High structural deck load capacity with two foldable cranes for versatile cargo handling.

hotspots.name: High Discharge Rates
hotspots.description: Optimised manifold system enabling high-speed discharge of liquid cargo to platform and rig clients.

hotspots.name: Dynamic Positioning
hotspots.description: DP II class dynamic positioning system with AUTR redundancy, enabling safe station-keeping near offshore installations.

hotspots.name: Emissions
hotspots.description: IMO Tier III compliant exhaust aftertreatment via Selective Catalytic Reduction (SCR), minimising NOx emissions.

hotspots.name: Energy Storage
hotspots.description: Hybrid-ready architecture with a 300 kWh battery Energy Storage System for peak shaving and zero-emission port operations.

hotspots.name: Bow Thrusters
hotspots.description: Two fixed-pitch bow thrusters providing lateral thrust for precision manoeuvring in confined harbours and alongside platforms.

hotspots.name: Propulsion
hotspots.description: Diesel-electric propulsion driving two azimuth thrusters with fixed-pitch propellers in nozzles for high efficiency and manoeuvrability.
